findings.problem: The word "grace" is on stop 1, card 18, in the answer "Good works that earn His grace". But the grace entry lists only cards 9 and 13, so card 18 gets no pop-up.

rule.text: **cards:** every card the word appears on

findings.problem: The entry for "walked" gives "BSB footnote" as a source. The only BSB footnote for this passage is on Ephesians 2:10 ("Literally which God prepared beforehand, that we should walk in them."). That footnote gives a literal wording of verse 10. It does not explain what "walked" means in Ephesians 2:2, so it should not be listed as a source for this meaning.

rule.text: Use the BSB footnotes first, when they explain the word.
